correctness.rationale: Connected Laplacian maximum principle forces all period-two vertices to fire once. Necessary and sufficient chip-height intervals have exactly the opposite-neighbor count choices. Forced leaf opposition and even-parity cycle boundary words give the exact product enumerator. Trace parity projection yields the interface polynomial; characteristic polynomials yield the closed count and universal sign correction. 1,864,640 direct candidate states checked in six cases plus transfer and phase integer checks through \(n=30,r=15\); these computations support, but are not substitutes for, the proof.

value.rationale: The family is the canonical unicyclic ring with a uniform number of pendant branches, and primitive recurrent orbit counts are natural finite-dynamics invariants. The theorem identifies every interface coefficient, all ring lengths and all positive leaf multiplicities, and an unexpected \((-1)^n\) correction independent of leaf multiplicity. It quantifies exponentially different chip-state multiplicity when a core ring is decorated, complementing but not merely restating known firing-pattern and period-length analyses.
